verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents Slack and PagerDuty integrations, lets users choose which error events trigger notifications, and offers threshold-based BadgerQL alarms plus anomaly detection for error-volume spikes, which together cover routing to channels and frequency-spike alerting. The evidence never shows routing by environment or severity, per-rule affected-user-count thresholds, or email as a routed destination. Missing for 10: documented environment/severity-based routing rules, affected-user-count thresholds, explicit email routing, and independent corroboration.
